body: Spec §12 V1. With CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN set, does Claude Code in a home with its own keychain login use the env token, with no prompt and without overwriting the stored login? Which env vars beat it? Decides whether home-B-on-quota-A works at all and the unset list in §7. Check: run claude in ~/.claude-work with the env set, /status, see which account's usage moves. Read-only, one throwaway token; write the result back into §12.
title: V1: does CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN beat a home's own keychain login?
